steps.prompt: New quest: read {quest} (and the GDD sections and code it cites). Write the spec to {run}/spec.md following your role card, with numbered test cases and hand-checked expected values. Reply when it's written.

prompt.un-automate-monde: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Implement it in the source files the spec assigns the builder, and nothing else. Run .crew/gate.sh before replying.
prompt.le-testeur: Spec: {run}/spec.md (quest: {quest}). Write its test cases in the test file the spec assigns the tester, and nothing else. The builder is coding in parallel.

steps.prompt: Run the gate (.crew/gate.sh) and write the gate note to {run}/gate-note.md as your role card says.

Review the round's changes against {run}/spec.md and {quest}: git diff for edited files, and read the new files (git status lists them). This round adds a local HTTP bridge that can approve a crew member's shell command, so review it like security code: 127.0.0.1 only; token and exact Origin checked before anything; the member must be in crew.json; allow only when blocked, the current prompt's hash equals prompt-id, and the prompt is neither risky nor unknown; risky is decided in the bridge; no shell (herdr called with an argument vector); length caps; the log never holds the token; nothing beyond names, states and the parsed prompt leaves a screen. Also: no member sent keys or prompts to the crew; pure logic tested; names from the roster. Write the review to {run}/review.md.
